<document id="products-credit">
CreditˆcardsˆandˆloansˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆcreditˆcards,ˆpersonalˆloans,ˆmortgages,ˆautoˆloansˆorˆlinesˆofˆcredit.ˆ##ˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆdebitˆcardˆItˆspendsˆmoneyˆthat'sˆalreadyˆinˆyourˆaccount.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆbuildˆcreditˆhistoryˆandˆdoesn'tˆappearˆonˆyourˆcreditˆreport.ˆ##ˆIsˆCushionˆaˆloan?ˆCushionˆcoversˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆwithˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterest.ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆlineˆofˆcredit,ˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus,ˆandˆisˆrepaidˆautomaticallyˆfromˆyourˆnextˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆCreditˆchecksˆWeˆdon'tˆrunˆaˆhardˆcreditˆcheckˆwhenˆyouˆopenˆanˆaccount.ˆ##ˆPayingˆaˆloanˆorˆcardˆfromˆanotherˆlenderˆYouˆcanˆpayˆotherˆlendersˆfromˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆbyˆACH,ˆusingˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆcredit?ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆlendersˆorˆgiveˆadviceˆaboutˆborrowing.ˆ##ˆCreditˆreportsˆBecauseˆweˆdon'tˆlend,ˆweˆdon'tˆreportˆyourˆaccountˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆAˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆwon'tˆraiseˆorˆlowerˆyourˆcreditˆscore.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="atm-limits">
ATMˆwithdrawalˆlimitsˆHowˆmuchˆcashˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆoutˆeachˆdayˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆTheˆlimitˆcoversˆallˆATMsˆcombined,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆTheˆdailyˆlimitˆresetsˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆraiseˆmyˆlimit?ˆNo.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthemˆforˆaˆdayˆorˆmakeˆexceptions.ˆTheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆaˆhigherˆlimitˆisˆtoˆchangeˆplan.ˆ##ˆATMˆlimitsˆversusˆtheˆATM'sˆownˆlimitˆManyˆATMsˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆmaximumˆperˆwithdrawalˆthat'sˆlowerˆthanˆours.ˆIfˆyouˆneedˆmore,ˆyouˆcanˆmakeˆmoreˆthanˆoneˆwithdrawal,ˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆstaysˆwithinˆyourˆdailyˆlimit.ˆEachˆwithdrawalˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆmayˆcarryˆaˆfee.ˆCashˆwithdrawalsˆareˆneverˆcoveredˆbyˆCushion.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-account-takeover">
IfˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆelseˆhasˆsignedˆinˆtoˆyourˆaccount,ˆactˆfast.ˆ##ˆSignsˆtoˆlookˆforˆ-ˆAˆpasswordˆchangeˆorˆnew-deviceˆsign-inˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆ-ˆYourˆemailˆaddressˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆchangedˆwithoutˆyouˆ-ˆTransfersˆorˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆyouˆdidn'tˆsendˆ-ˆYou'reˆsuddenlyˆsignedˆoutˆandˆcan'tˆsignˆbackˆinˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆin,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆfreezeˆyourˆcards.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆcallˆusˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆ##ˆWhatˆwe'llˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆandˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆaccountˆtakeovers.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆusuallyˆmuchˆfaster.ˆTheyˆmayˆsignˆoutˆeveryˆdevice,ˆresetˆyourˆcredentialsˆandˆreviewˆrecentˆactivityˆwithˆyou.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆtransfersˆorˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆduringˆaˆtakeoverˆinvestigation.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆdoesˆthatˆonceˆthey'veˆconfirmedˆwhoˆyouˆare.ˆ##ˆAfterwardˆCheckˆyourˆemailˆaccount'sˆsecurityˆtoo.ˆManyˆtakeoversˆstartˆwithˆaˆcompromisedˆemail.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
